Pod detail shows Last State Terminated, Reason Error, Exit Code 2 (not 137/OOMKilled), Liveness: grpc <pod>:3551 vs Readiness: grpc <pod>:3550. Pod events bind the mechanism verbatim: 'Warning Unhealthy ... Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.2.238:3551" within 1s: context deadline exceeded' and 'Normal Killing ... Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted'. GetAppYAML confirms the reference mismatch: containerPort 3550, env PORT=3550, readinessProbe.grpc.port 3550, but livenessProbe.grpc.port 3551. server.go starts exactly one listener on the PORT env value and the container log reads 'starting grpc server at :3550', so nothing ever listens on 3551. Counter-check CheckServiceConnectivity(productcatalogservice:3550) returns open/Connection Succeeded, so the business port itself is healthy and the break is purely the liveness probe port, causing the restart loop.
